item.title: Trump to Lead TSMC Groundbreaking in Arizona After Nvidia Gambit
item.description: US President Trump is scheduled to lead the groundbreaking ceremony for the TSMC Arizona fab on December 4. This event serves to highlight the political commitment to onshoring advanced chip manufacturing, with market participants closely watching for policy signals regarding incentives, tariffs, and production timelines.

item.title: Behind Binance Hack, a Reckoning Over Who Controls Crypto
item.description: During the $6.3 billion hack of Binance, stablecoin issuers Tether and Circle froze $1.5 billion in USDT and $1.1 billion in USDC within 30 minutes, respectively. This action marks a significant shift as the two issuers utilized centralized control over their smart contracts to execute immediate asset blocks upon requests from government authorities and the affected exchange.

item.title: AI agents now control part of Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement remains distant
item.description: Google DeepMind VP of Research Koray Kavukcuoglu announced that AI agents now manage partial compute for Gemini experiments, transitioning from project-specific teams to a unified general-purpose algorithm architecture. This shift aims to accelerate iteration cycles while preventing recursive self-improvement to maintain human-verifiable control over model reasoning.

item.title: OpenAI publishes a preprint that claims to prove that the matrix multiplication exponent (ω) is exactly 9/4, addressing a major open problem in mathematics (alphaXiv)
item.description: OpenAI published a preprint proving that the square matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4 over any field. Utilizing formal arithmetic circuits and proof by contradiction, the research bridges matrix multiplication efficiency with lower bounds on network compression costs, filling a critical gap in asymptotic rank and unrestricted circuit complexity.

item.title: PrismML shrinks a 54 GB language model to 5.9 GB by reducing every weight to just three possible values
item.description: Startup PrismML has released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, an updated version of its aggressively compressed language model. It's based on Qwen3.8-27B and takes up just 5.9 GB of memory, same as its predecessor. That's possible because of ternary quantization, where each weight can only be one of three values (−1, 0, or +1) instead of the usual 16-bit storage. item.title: Asia Data Centers Sound Out US Clients to Replace China Demand
item.description: The US Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) issued an interim final rule, effective around November 16, 2026, targeting remote access to high-end AI compute by Chinese entities at non-US data centers. Facilities providing significant compute, exceeding 12 million aggregate TPP, are required to implement enhanced due diligence and obtain licenses, facing potential trade restrictions for non-compliance.
